CMT-015.excerpt: (1) HEADROOM PROBE: the ceiling check verifies the LIMIT, not the HEADROOM — a machine at 1900 of 2048 reports fine. A fork-based count fails exactly when the limit is exhausted, so this needs a non-forking (native) process count. Until it lands, any FUTURE change to the ceiling value is blocked on it, because a ceiling change is precisely the decision that needs headroom baselines — 2048 was chos
